{{Top|leg}}
'''Bolgoink Fair''' was the first of the major interclan fairs staged by the [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorreans]], held annually during the early season of [[Slushtime]]. It was a smaller affair compared to the [[Jugsmuk Fair]].
